{{Quote|I'm not a Jawa, and it's a trick. He spotted you, and he's lured us to this crowded, confusing place so he can lose us.|The Sullustan assassin, about Garik Loran|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''assassin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]]<ref name="TERC" />, he and [[Unidentified Human assassin (Garik Loran)|two]] [[Unidentified Aqualish assassin|other]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Attempted assassination on Garik Loran|tried]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Wraith Squadron]] leader [[Garik Loran]] at a [[Unidentified Coruscant pedestrian market|pedestrian market]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, Loran [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Sullustan assassin instead by stabbing him with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="MK" />
